Turns out the original study missed an important factor. A large portion of the people at a healthy current weight that died prematurely were once morbidly obese.

In each of those cases, the fatty suffered an illness that drastically reduced their weight. They assumed all was well now, but the study showed that statistically it would be a precursor to death. Their were a few exceptions of course, but they all returned to the human race over a large period of time and through their own efforts.

Moral of this story? Lose fat in a healthy way, or die from fat diseases.
